subject.title: fix: compaction usage guards and agent-loop turn correctness

question: Should `AgentOptions.prepareNextTurnWithContext` become a permanent public plugin API alongside `prepareNextTurn`, or should the context-aware adaptation remain internal to AgentSession?
rationale: The branch changes the generated plugin SDK surface to solve an internal session-loop refresh problem; repository policy requires owner intent before establishing a parallel long-lived plugin contract.

options.title: Approve the additive hook
options.body: Keep `prepareNextTurnWithContext` as a backward-compatible public hook, document its precedence, and retain focused compatibility coverage for existing `prepareNextTurn` consumers.

options.title: Keep the adaptation internal
options.body: Remove the new public hook and solve the session refresh requirement behind the AgentSession wrapper or another private agent-core seam.

recommendation.title: Approve the additive hook
recommendation.body: Keep `prepareNextTurnWithContext` as a backward-compatible public hook, document its precedence, and retain focused compatibility coverage for existing `prepareNextTurn` consumers.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent compaction history and is the repository's documented primary product decision owner.
